articles.title: United Launch Alliance announces mid-November return to flight for Vulcan rocket
articles.summary: The anticipated launch will be the first for the heavy-lift rocket since a mid-flight nozzle failure on a solid rocket booster. The rocket will carry 40 Amazon Leo satellites to orbit.
